name: DMC2 Mini
notes: Price is the DIY kit (sale price, regular USD 2,700; CAD pricing also offered); the assembled machine is USD 4,500 (regular 4,800) and currently out of stock. Kit includes coolant and lubrication system, 15-piece ER20 collet set and all electronics (no computer or fluids); estimated 20 h build. Ships from Canada; non-North-American buyers need a shipping quote. Accuracy = vendor-stated achievable part tolerance / motor accuracy (0.01 mm, not guaranteed for a kit). Feed = max rapid. Includes Mach3 controller board; can be swapped for LinuxCNC or GRBL. X/Y/Z automatic probing with an included probe. Travel converted from 12 x 7 x 5.5 in; footprint excludes the extra 3 in for motors. 4th axis optional.

accessories.name: Shariff DMC 4th Axis
accessories.description: 4th-axis add-on for the DMC2 Mini/DMC2 with 4-jaw chuck, belt reducer, closed-loop motor, homing sensor, driver and wiring (some assembly required).

accessories.name: MPG Jogwheel
accessories.description: Plug-and-play Mach3 handwheel pendant with 0.01/0.1/1 mm jog increments and magnetic back for probing and positioning.

accessories.name: 4″ Precision Ground Vise
accessories.description: Precision-ground vise with 4 in opening and approx. 2.9 in jaw width, incl. mounting hardware.
